meta.name: process:mail_routing
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C1c; DECISIONS 231): the routing of emailed documents as a process pack (until C1c its own kind of package). A case reads the email packages its scope names: every PDF attachment that arrived in them is proposed for the package of its party, period and role, and a person accepts, rejects or redirects each one; the case is done once every attachment it can route is decided. The emails that start a case of another process (an IT quote) are listed with those cases. Every step names a general capability; the pack holds no code.

changelog.note: 231 (U1e; the owner's decision of 2026-10-28): its example material: the invented own party its invoices belong to, and how it is tried (a download of the invented consultancy's mailbox first).
231 (U0): what the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of

231 (C1c): the first version: the routing step (file_placement@1) and its tabs: Emails, Routing, Routed, Started cases, History; an email package's page offers a case that reads it; the routing packages made before are taken over as its cases.

title: Email routing
summary: The documents of emails already downloaded, sent where they belong: invoices, outgoing invoices and bank statements to their packages, a quote request to a case of its own.

examples.note: First download the invented consultancy's mailbox (the Emails from a mailbox process) and approve its run, then route that download: its two invoices go to the consultancy's outgoing invoices, its quote request starts an IT quote.
